title: Curated facts (orchestrator)
description: Every entry carries source + url. moon.json: atmospheres, lunar_margins, paper_tests, gap. incidents.json: incidents. Atmosphere ids are what story stage.reference points to.

o2_pct_max.description: null = open band, drawn from o2_pct_min to 100 % as a dashed band; never used in DISTANCE

pictures.description: pictures.json: real NASA photographs. title and caption are word for word from the NASA Image and Video Library record of nasa_id; alt is ours. The image files sit beside the file, in data/curated/pictures/.

caption.description: a word-for-word part of the NASA record's description
